name: AP_IDR_OPTIONS
description: AP_IDR_OPTIONS contains the parameters and defaults you define for operating your Intelligent Document Recognition system. This table contains information such as imaging email id, business unit defaulting option and your data handling options. Your Oracle Payables application also uses this information to determine default values while importing the image invoices from IDR. This table corresponds to the Intelligent Document Recognition Options window. There is only one row in this table.

columns.name: IDR_OPTIONS_ID
columns.description: Indicates the unique identifier associated to the row .

columns.name: IDR_EMAIL
columns.description: The Email address that you have to send the images for processing by Intelligent Document Recognition.

columns.name: BU_DERIVATION_BASIS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the basis for derivation of business unit for image invoices created by Intelligent Document Recognition.

columns.name: BU_EMAIL_MAPPING
columns.description: Mapping of business unit with Email to derive the BU that is stamped on the invoice based on the email from which the image is sent.

columns.name: USE_TAX_AMOUNT_AS_CONTROL_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if the recognized tax amount must be considered as tax control amount for the entire invoice (Y or N). It will ensure that the calculated tax is the same as on the physical document.

columns.name: IMPORT_FREIGHT_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if the recognized freight amount must be imported to Fusion Payables (Y or N).

columns.name: ENFORCE_INCOMPLETE_STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether all Image invoices must be imported to Fusion Payables in Incomplete validation status.

columns.name: CALC_TAX_DURING_IMPORT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether tax should be calculated for the image invoices during import (Y or N).

columns.name: IMPORT_PAIRED_LINES_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if the unmatched lines recognized for matched invoices must be imported to Fusion Payables (Y or N).

columns.name: IMPORT_LINES_MATCHED_FLAG
columns.description: A value of Y indicates that the lines recognized for matched invoices must be imported to Fusion Payables.

columns.name: IMPORT_LINES_UNMATCHED_FLAG
columns.description: A value of Y indicates that the lines recognized for unmatched invoices must be imported to Fusion Payables.

columns.name: SINGLE_LINE_AMOUNT_PO_FLAG
columns.description: A value of Y indicates that system will create single matched line for invoices matched to amount based purchase orders.

columns.name: SINGLE_LINE_UTILITY_INV_FLAG
columns.description: A value of Y indicates that system will create single invoice line for invoices created on suppliers categorized as Utility vendors.

columns.name: PROCESS_DOC_ATTACHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if you allow processing of DOC type attachments by Intelligent Document Recognition (Y or N).

columns.name: PROCESS_DOCX_ATTACHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if you allow processing of DOCX type attachments by Intelligent Document Recognition (Y or N).

columns.name: PROCESS_PDF_ATTACHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if you allow processing of PDF type attachments by Intelligent Document Recognition (Y or N).

columns.name: PROCESS_TIFF_ATTACHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if you allow processing of TIFF type attachments by Intelligent Document Recognition (Y or N).

columns.name: PROCESS_PNG_ATTACHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if you allow processing of PNG type attachments by Intelligent Document Recognition (Y or N).

columns.name: PROCESS_JPEG_ATTACHMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates if you allow processing of JPEG type attachments by Intelligent Document Recognition (Y or N).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.description: The domain name used to recognize and extract requester email from the invoice document.

columns.name: VALIDATE_PO_LE_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether the legal entity recognized for matched invoices must be validated with the legal entity on the purchase order available in the Fusion Purchasing. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: CONVERT_EMAIL_INTO_ATTACH_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the email should be converted into an attachment to the invoice. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: IDR_ACTIVATION_STATUS
columns.description: Activation status for Intelligent Document Recognition (IDR). Possible values are ACTIVE and INACTIVE
